rules.title: General liability cap
rules.guidance: The cap protects us when the Provider fails.

rules.title: Payment period
rules.guidance: We pay on our standard cycle.
rules.acceptable: Between 30 and 60 days from the invoice.

rules.title: Security breach notice
rules.guidance: We must hear of a breach quickly.
rules.escalation: No fixed period, or more than 72 hours.

rules.title: Security of Customer Content
rules.guidance: All our data must be protected.
rules.preferred: Reasonable safeguards over all data we submit.
rules.acceptable: Reasonable safeguards over all data we submit.
rules.escalation: Safeguards at the Provider's discretion, or a narrowed definition of Customer Content.
